verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some indirect latency-vs-completeness levers. The agent lets you set how much reasoning it spends on a task. Async jobs and webhooks report when a crawl, batch scrape or agent job starts, progresses or finishes, so you can act on results without waiting for polling. None of this documents fine-grained control over exactly when a scrape returns its content. Missing for 10: documented wait/timeout or early-return parameters on scrape, partial-result semantics for crawls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
